en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a wide river with a long, narrow riverbank and a pathway running alongside it. On the near side there is a wooded hillside dotted with detached houses and villas with steep, tiled roofs. In the river, several barges or boats are visible. On the far shore lie more houses and small buildings, with low hills and forested slopes in the background. The image has the proportions, border, and wear consistent with an early 20th‑century photographic postcard. No printed title or caption is visible.
